title: OperationExpired
description: Data payload of a -32005 JSON-RPC error: a call whose declared lifetime ran out. Before any effect the reason is 'not-started' (nothing was changed and the same action may be asked again); after one it is the catalogue entry's own expired outcome — 'outcome-unknown' for a mutation that may have happened, 'retry-read' for a read that changed nothing. The reason is the catalogue's enum, never free text, and it is the only field: a call that did not start carries no scope, no retry hint and nothing from the request. ADR-8eej3e66 stage 8 removed the -32004 capacity refusal this replaces.

reason.description: The catalogue's declared outcome at the deadline.
